Marissa / Neha — forwarding Jamie's questions from FinTechCo (below). Can you help with concise answers I can send back this morning? Key asks: default Hosted API rate limits and how fast we can bump for trials; data residency/retention defaults; SSO/SCIM support; and a short blurb on the Dedicated threshold so I can manage expectations if their P95 is high.

Suggested quick answers (draft):
- Rate limits: default per-account soft limit is 60 requests/min and 500k tokens/min aggregate; burst capacity handled by queuing + soft bursts. For evaluations we can temporarily raise to 600 rps or increase token throughput for 2 weeks — need approval from infra (Neha).
- Data residency: Hosted API stores logs in our primary US region (us-west-2) by default; retention is 30 days for request logs and 90 days for aggregated telemetry (configurable with enterprise add-on).
- SSO/SCIM: We support SAML-based SSO for the console and SCIM provisioning on Dedicated/Private; for Hosted accounts we can enable SAML for org-managed accounts — full SCIM is available on Enterprise plan.
- Dedicated threshold: typical customers move to Dedicated when sustained throughput exceeds ~40–60K tokens/min or when they require strict isolation + SLA.

If you can refine/correct the numbers I'll respond to Jamie. Also flag any compliance caveats (esp. around log retention + pay-per-request traces).

Thanks —Aditya

Jamie — thanks for the great questions. Answers below and next steps: we've attached the quickstart + a sample usage CSV and I can provision a sandbox API key with a temporary quota bump today if you confirm.

1) Rate limits / concurrency:
- Default (Hosted API): soft limits are 60 requests/min and ~500k tokens/min per account. Hard throttles kick in above that.
- Evaluation bump: we can temporarily raise throughput to support up to 600 rps or ~2M tokens/min for a 2-week pilot (requires enablement from our infra team). Tell me the concurrency profile you expect (rps and average tokens per request) and I'll request the bump.

2) Data residency & retention:
- Default: request logs and prompts are stored in our US primary region (us-west-2).
- Retention: request logs 30 days by default; aggregated telemetry 90 days. Enterprise add-ons allow extended retention and custom region controls.

3) SSO / SCIM:
- SAML SSO: supported for Redwood Console and org-managed Hosted accounts (we can enable for FinTechCo).
- SCIM: full SCIM provisioning is available for Dedicated/Private customers; for Hosted we support invite flows and org-managed directories — we can discuss SCIM if you plan to move to Dedicated.

4) Path to Dedicated capacity:
- Typical threshold: customers consider Dedicated when sustained workloads are ~40–60K tokens/min or when isolation/SLA is required. If your sandbox telemetry shows sustained P95 > 200ms, we'll run an assessment and provide an estimate for Dedicated sizing and pricing.

Next steps:
- I'll provision a sandbox key with a temporary quota bump once you confirm expected RPS/tokens.
- Meeting: Tue 4/20 10:00am PT — invite accepted, we'll review early telemetry and adjust.
